title: Low-Stock Alerts
summary: A Google Sheet that will work out when each product runs out and email purchasing before it happens.
result: Alerts fire when stock no longer covers supplier lead time plus a one-week buffer, with a suggested order quantity for 45 days.

metric.label: on top of supplier lead time: the alert fires when stock no longer covers both

note: Screens and video are mock-ups with fictitious store data.

screenshots.alt: Stock sheet: days of cover, reorder point, suggested order and status per SKU
Daily alert email listing products to reorder now and this week

upworkBlurb: Demo project. Low-stock alerts in Google Sheets + Apps Script for a small online store: 30 days of sales imported from a store CSV export, then per product the average daily sales, days of stock left, a reorder point (supplier lead time plus a one-week buffer) and a suggested order for 45 days. A script will check every morning at 7am and email purchasing what to reorder, with a reorder log and a Settings tab. Fictitious store data. Stack: Google Sheets, Apps Script, Gmail.
